headline.text: L1 S4 spatula found in mixing tank at 07:59 — full system clean and line restart by *11:15*, no contamination confirmed.

per_plant_summary.L1: S1 had a rough morning with riser pump blockages and belt skipping but cleared by midday and ran the rest of the shift. S4 discovered a broken spatula in the mixing tank at 07:59, executed a full system clean, and restarted by 11:15. S1 is running with heavy piece weights requiring a count workaround. S2 moved to Labeler B after A wouldn't stop wrinkling.
per_plant_summary.L2: Three quick mechanical stops across ML2 (silver adjustment, mold jam, Theegarten jam) all cleared inside 20 minutes. ML3 ran clean with two brief label breaks on 2nd shift. FFS had a film jam at midday that cleared, then bags started coming out open late in the shift while cleaning. ML2 seeing broken bars at demold as of 14:42.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 spent the morning fighting depositor cavity-fill issues until Klaus enabled double deposit at 09:37 and the line came good. Truffle Line borrowed a Cavanna sensor from ML1 to stay running. MF Matrix suction cups adjusted by 09:36. TG4 assembly errors discovered during afternoon inspection.

notes.text: Reminder sent to all leads: do not use utility knives to cut plastic when winding the blue roller on the labeling machine.
Xray and printers on S1 were not shut down properly; continued procedure violations may damage equipment long-term.
Flow wrap for Truffle Line was not staged Sunday night; staging verification process needs tightening.
Schedule change: grinding grahams moved up to start 2nd shift today and 3rd shift tonight; staffing and material staging in progress.

resolved.title: S1 riser pump high pressure faults and blockages
resolved.summary: Riser pump faulted on startup with high pressure, then continued shutting off when tempering; unheated pipe section caused hard chocolate buildup and valve blockage.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 12:04 — Jakob removed and washed valve to clear blockage, decorator came to temper, and "Line is running right now" (S1 Enrober).

resolved.title: S4 spatula broken inside mixing tank
resolved.summary: Metal scraper blade and plastic handle pieces found in mixing tank and filter; full caramel batch drained, entire system cleaned and inspected.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 11:15 — metal part recovered from tank, plastic cleared from filter, all piping/tank/kettle cleaned and sanitized, first batch made, viscosity in range, "started running continuously" (Marcos Jimenez).

resolved.title: Packaging belt skipping violently all morning
resolved.summary: Belt tensioners on first and second conveyors were left in release position after shutdown, causing violent skipping from start of shift.
resolved.resolution: Tensioners corrected by 09:30 — "Packaging belts are now functional" (Matt Hatch). Matt will remove the last two tensioner handles to prevent future confusion.

resolved.title: S2 Labeler A producing wrinkled labels
resolved.summary: Jar labels coming out wrinkled on Labeler A; Troy unable to eliminate wrinkles after adjustments.
resolved.resolution: Workaround at 08:15 — "I couldn't get Labeler A to have no wrinkles. We've moved to Labeler B" (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: Pretzels jamming between metal detector and ES conveyor
resolved.summary: Gap between metal detector and blue ES conveyor catching pretzels; metal detector also drifting and guard plate set up incorrectly.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:36 — "moved the MD closer to the incline belt and we found a cover that was loose. Problem is fixed for now" (Justin Garner). Chris J also adjusted the guard plate.

resolved.title: ML2 bars jamming at Theegarten entrance
resolved.summary: Bars jamming at entrance of Theegarten wrapper; maintenance performed hard reset, then Theegarten door faulted requiring second hard reset.
resolved.resolution: Running by 12:00 — "Line star running 12:00 pm" (ML2 FW). Maintenance also checked vacuum and cleaned chocolate from belts.

resolved.title: ML2 mold jam at demolder
resolved.summary: Mold jam stopped the line at the demolder station.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:04 — "Line back up" (Jeffrey Barney), 11 minutes down.

resolved.title: FFS film passed through machine
resolved.summary: Film jammed or passed through incorrectly, line down.
resolved.resolution: Running at 13:18 — "Line is running" (VFFS), cleared in 21 minutes.

resolved.title: ML2 line down for large silver changeover
resolved.summary: Line stopped to adjust PG19 and PG20 for large silver product.
resolved.resolution: Back up at 06:26 — "Line is running" (Jeffrey Barney), 12 minutes down.

resolved.title: ML3 label breaks on wrapper
resolved.summary: Two brief label breaks on 2nd shift, line stopped both times.
resolved.resolution: Both breaks cleared quickly — first at 14:13 ("Line running"), second at 14:54 ("Line running again"). Operator cleaned vacuum lines and checked roller tightness.

resolved.title: ML4 depositor not filling cavities completely
resolved.summary: Depositor unable to fill bar cavities all the way despite maxing out settings; bars not demolding, chocolate drops on molds, circuit 2 fault on depositor 2.
resolved.resolution: Resolved at 09:37 — Klaus updated programming to enable double deposit on depositor 1, "Depositing double now. Cavity's are all the way full" (Itzel Chavez), full molds demolding properly.

resolved.title: MF Matrix bag opener suction cups not working
resolved.summary: Bag opening having a lot of trouble, suction cups not working correctly, maintenance busy on another line.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 09:36 — "Maintenance adjusted the suction cups" (Rich Brierley).

resolved.title: Truffle Line Cute Cavanna printer sensor failed
resolved.summary: Printer font size getting bigger on its own then returning to normal; sensor needs replacement but none in inventory at any location.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 10:32 — "borrowed a sensor from ML1 Cavanna that wasn't in use" (Nathan Ruiz), 5 sensors on order, Cute Cavanna good to go.

resolved.title: Truffle Line Cute Cavanna film not sealing
resolved.summary: Truffle pieces coming out open, film not sealing properly, several packs unsealed coming out of machine.
resolved.resolution: Running better by 13:45 — Chris Givens adjusted jaws and operator changed film roll, "The seal improved" (Mirella) at 13:29, "running better now" at 13:45.

resolved.title: Truffle Line temper range not displaying in QIsoft
resolved.summary: Operator took two temperature readings but program not showing the range; using paper chart as backup.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 07:08 — Shawn added temper ranges and production break in QIsoft, "now have temper ranges" after reload.

needs_attention.title: Hapman lids and cones failed environmental swabs
needs_attention.summary: High environmental test results on Hapman lids and cones; parts need multiple recleans with APC swabs after each clean.
needs_attention.status: Requires 3 recleans with APC swab after each clean per Charity at 14:11. Inline filter also flagged but results still pending due to lab issue as of 14:12.

needs_attention.title: S2 Labeler A still producing wrinkled labels
needs_attention.summary: After moving to Labeler B in the morning, Area A labeler still having issues as of midday; Chris and Troy working on it while Area B compensates.
needs_attention.status: As of 12:54 Chris and Troy working on Area A, Area B running fine. One roll placed on hold for cut-off printing. No confirmation Area A was repaired by window close.

needs_attention.title: S1 final piece weight 35% over spec
needs_attention.summary: Enrobed pretzel pieces weighing 8.2g vs 6.07g max spec, causing bags to hit 576g pouch weight with only 65 pieces instead of target 85+; blower and shaker both at 100%.
needs_attention.status: Running with workaround as of 13:50 — confirmed can go as low as 85 pieces per pouch as long as pouch weight is met. First 4 pallets placed on hold for low count, rework ordered. Root cause (excessive chocolate) not addressed.

needs_attention.title: S1 Eagle Stone conveyor gap dropping pretzels to floor
needs_attention.summary: Gap between Eagle Stone conveyor feeding Matrix 9 and the ramp allowing pretzels to fall through, wasting product.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance request sent to Matt Hatch, Dakota Adair, and Chris Jeffs at 15:13. No response by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML2 broken bars coming through demolding
needs_attention.summary: Estimated 4 broken bars per mold coming through demolder; worker manually removing bars from belt to prevent packaging.
needs_attention.status: Line leader notified at 14:42. Adjustments made at 14:54 (demolding hammers changed from 2.2 to 1.9, caramel temp raised from 47 to 49). No confirmation issue resolved by window close.

needs_attention.title: FFS bags coming out open
needs_attention.summary: Bags not sealing properly, coming out open from the VFFS machine.
needs_attention.status: Cleaning machine as of 14:53. Maintenance (Brandon Lance, Mathew Draper) tagged. No follow-up by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG4 wrapper assembly errors
needs_attention.summary: Multiple installation errors discovered on TG4: rollers on wrong location on turning belt, conveyor M270 installed above rails causing belt rip, plastic piece installed outside instead of inside metal detector bin.
needs_attention.status: Documented at 12:29. Nelson replaced M270 belt. No confirmation all installation errors corrected by window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line missing bolt on splitter cover
needs_attention.summary: One bolt missing from the splitter cover.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 04:22. No follow-up on replacement or impact by window close.
